old: Shelf 4 -> 8 items by level (row 71). Restocks every 5 completed battles, same as the Merchant (row 15, economy_framework 18/48). The shelf is seeded (same save and battle count = same shelf), each shelf item can be bought once, and no item appears twice on one shelf. Each consumable has a fixed tier (Common 52, Uncommon 4, Rare 82, Epic 2; the Uncommon and Epic items are all Recovery). Each shelf slot rolls a tier from the level odds (row 71); if no unlocked item exists at that tier, it drops to the next tier down. The 7 types (Recovery, Damage, Support, Utility, Control, Environment, Deployable) unlock by level (row 71); all 20 Deployables are Rare. Buy price = the existing list price (economy_framework 27, consumable_framework 30-32: 25g-480g) minus 3% per level above L1 (L10 = -27%), like the Blacksmith, Runeforge and Crucible. Price does not depend on map level (consumables scale with the user's level, consumable_framework 3). Sell price (at the Apothecary) = floor(list price x 20% x charges left / max charges), not changed by Apothecary level. Equipped items and items on units out on dispatch cannot be sold. Loop check: you buy for at least 73% and sell for at most 20%; refilling an empty item at L10 costs 25% and selling it gives 20%, so every route loses gold.

old: Charges refill automatically at the Return to base step (game_flow 20) and the refill COSTS GOLD from the start of the game (Decision 2 = A). Refill cost per item = ceil(list price x charges missing / max charges x refill rate); whole-number math: ceil(list x missing x rate% / (max x 100)). The rate is measured against the LIST price and already includes the level discount (the 3% buy discount is NOT applied on top). Rate for a full refill: 75% before the Apothecary is built and at L1, then L2 69%, L3 64%, L4 58%, L5 53%, L6 47%, L7 42%, L8 36%, L9 31%, L10 25% (75 - round(50 x (L - 1) / 9)). Refilling always costs less than buying a new copy (L1 75% vs 100%, L10 25% vs 73%). Which items: every owned consumable missing charges, equipped ones first. Gold short: refill one charge at a time in roster order then slot order, stop at the first charge you can't afford; gold never goes below 0; items not refilled stay partly used (never destroyed) and the base screen shows "X charges not refilled - need Yg". Auto-refill switch (on by default) plus a "Refill now" button in the Apothecary; with the switch off nothing refills automatically and the player refills by hand. Used-up items stay at 0 charges and are never destroyed (consumable_framework 1). In-battle refills stay free (Potion Desk, the Restock skill, Preservation Case AC-008, Field Alchemist Emblem AC-018); expedition camps still don't refill (game_flow 19). Per-charge examples, L1 / L10: Common Routine 50g (4 ch) 9.4g / 3.1g; Common Standard 75g (3 ch) 18.8g / 6.3g; Rare Heavy 220g (2 ch) 82.5g / 27.5g; Rare Battlefield 320g (1 ch) 240g / 80g; Epic Battlefield 480g (1 ch) 360g / 120g.
